{{Top|leg}}
The '''Moff Assembly Hall''' served as the meeting place for the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], it was still in use. The Assembly Hall was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ravelin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].
